features.name: Ash Cloud
features.description: At 2nd level, you can expend one use of Wild Shape to create a volcanic eruption at a point within 30 ft. Creatures within 5 ft make DEX save: 2d8 bludgeoning on fail (half on success). Creates a 20-ft-radius heavily obscured ash cloud. Creatures entering or starting turn in it make CON save or have disadvantage on ability checks and saves. You auto-succeed on your own cloud. Lasts 1 minute or until dismissed/dispersed.

features.name: Firesight
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, your vision can't be obscured by ash, fire, smoke, fog, or your Ash Cloud. Advantage on saves against gas/cloud effects.

**Covered in Ash (L6):** When a creature within 30 ft takes damage, use reaction to give it temp HP = 2 × proficiency bonus (before damage). Prof bonus uses/long rest. Also, teleport within your ash cloud as a bonus action (1/min).

features.name: Feed the Earth
features.description: At 10th level, your Ash Cloud becomes more potent: 10-ft radius eruption dealing 2d8 bludgeoning + 2d8 fire damage. Creatures in the cloud have disadvantage on checks/saves even without breathing. If damage is dealt, you can use reaction to create difficult terrain in the cloud. Lasts 10 minutes.

features.name: From the Ashes
features.description: Beginning at 14th level, when reduced to 0 HP, your body explodes. Chosen creatures within 30 ft make DEX save: 6d6 fire on fail (half on success). You become ashes. At end of your next turn, you reform with half max HP. 1/long rest.
